scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const ensure=(dir)=>fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); const copyContents=(src,dest)=>{ensure(dest); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})) { const srcPath=path.join(src, entry.name); const destPath=path.join(dest, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) { fs.cpSync(srcPath, destPath, { recursive: true }); } else { fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath); } } }; ensure('.next/standalone/public'); ensure('.next/standalone/.next/static'); copyContents('public', '.next/standalone/public'); copyContents('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static');"
